title: Lake Erie fish gather near low-oxygen zones as climate change reshapes habitat
summary_full: Fish in Lake Erie appear to gather near low-oxygen areas instead of steering clear of them, which reshapes the landscape of their habitat. This unexpected behavior not only changes how fish interact but also contradicts prior theories about their avoidance strategies. With climate change potentially worsening these hypoxic conditions, understanding these dynamics becomes vital for sustainable fisheries management and ecological monitoring.
